title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: Refund and Compensation Policy
content:
CultPass offers refunds under specific conditions:
- Event cancellation by organizer: Full refund or credit restored.
- Technical double-billing: Refund processed within 3-5 business days upon verification.
- User cancellation within 24 hours of purchase if event is > 48h away: Pass credit returned.
- Unused monthly quota is non-refundable and does not roll over.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Refunds are granted if an event is canceled by the organizer or if double billing occurs. Unused monthly pass credits expire at the end of each billing period."

title: Premium Experience Upgrades and Quota Usage
content:
Understanding premium experiences:
- Premium events display a star badge in the catalog and may deduct 2 pass credits or require a small top-up fee.
- Basic plan members can upgrade individual events to premium or upgrade their plan to Premium Tier for full access.
- Checking available slots and quota: View 'My Pass' tab in the app.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Premium experiences may require 2 pass credits or a small upgrade fee. You can check your remaining monthly credits in the 'My Pass' section of the app."

title: How to Transfer or Gift an Experience Pass
content:
Pass transfer guidelines:
- Users on Premium plan can transfer up to 1 reservation per month to a friend.
- Basic plan members cannot transfer passes directly; the ticket holder name must match the registered user.
- To gift a pass (Premium): Go to reservation details, tap 'Share/Gift Pass', and enter recipient email.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Premium subscribers can gift 1 pass per month via the 'Share/Gift Pass' option in the reservation screen. Basic tier passes are strictly non-transferable."

title: App Crash and Technical Troubleshooting
content:
Steps to resolve app crashes or loading errors:
1. Force close the CultPass app and restart.
2. Ensure the app is updated to the latest version via App Store or Google Play.
3. Clear app cache (Settings > Storage > CultPass > Clear Cache).
4. Check internet connection or switch from Wi-Fi to cellular data.
5. If issue persists, note down your OS version and contact support.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Please try force closing the app, clearing cache in your phone settings, and updating to the latest version. If the app still crashes, reach out with your phone OS version."

title: Family and Companion Access Guidelines
content:
Bringing guests and family members:
- Each CultPass reservation is valid for 1 individual unless marked 'Group/Family Pass'.
- Additional member passes can be added to an account under 'Family Add-on' for $9.99/mo per secondary user.
- Minors under 12 enter free at select partner venues (check venue details in-app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Standard reservations are per person. If you're attending with family, consider adding a Family Add-on to your subscription or booking secondary tickets directly."

title: Updating Payment Method and Billing Inquiries
content:
Managing payment methods:
- Update credit card or payment details under 'My Account' > 'Billing & Payment'.
- Accepted payment methods: Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) and digital wallets.
- If a payment fails, your subscription enters a 3-day grace period before being paused.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your payment method anytime in the app under 'My Account' > 'Billing & Payment'. If a payment fails, you have 3 days to update details before your pass is paused."

title: Venue Access, QR Codes, and Check-in Rules
content:
Check-in instructions at cultural venues:
- Open your active reservation in the app to display your digital QR code.
- Venues scan the QR code at entry. Screenshots are NOT accepted at partner venues with dynamic QR codes.
- Photo ID matching the account name may be requested by venue staff.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Show your live digital QR code from the CultPass app upon arrival. Please carry a valid photo ID as venue staff may verify account ownership."

title: Pausing Subscription vs Cancellation Rules
content:
Difference between Pausing and Canceling:
- Pause: Pause billing for up to 3 months. Your account history, favorites, and rewards are preserved.
- Cancellation: Terminates billing at current period end. Account defaults to Free tier.
- Reactivation: Can reactivate anytime with 1-click in the app.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Pausing keeps your saved preferences and freezes billing for up to 3 months. Canceling stops renewal while leaving your account on the free tier."

title: Account Security, Unrecognized Charges, and Blocked Accounts
content:
Handling security concerns:
- Unrecognized charge: Report to support immediately with transaction details.
- Blocked account: Accounts are automatically flagged if fraudulent activity or terms violation occurs. Contact support for identity verification and account review.
- Change password and enable 2-Factor Authentication in 'Account Settings'.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If your account is blocked or you see an unrecognized charge, please reply with your details so our security team can verify your identity and unblock your account."

title: Submitting Feedback and Rating Experiences
content:
How to review cultural experiences:
- After attending an event, a prompt will appear in the app to rate (1-5 stars) and review.
- Reviews help CultPass curate higher quality cultural events.
- Issue with an event organization? Report directly in the review screen or open a support ticket.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can rate and review past events under 'My History' in the app. If you experienced any venue issues, you can also submit direct feedback there."

title: Special Accessibility and Venue Requirements
content:
Accessibility details:
- Venue accessibility features (wheelchair access, audio assistance, sign language interpretation) are listed on each event details page under 'Venue Info'.
- For custom accessibility accommodations, contact support at least 48 hours prior to the event.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Accessibility information is available on each event page under 'Venue Info'. For special accommodation requests, let us know 48 hours in advance so we can assist."
